summary: Backend-only testing of ALBARKA iteration 4 (contacts carnet d'adresses, WA-on-upload guardrail, verified email domain settings, /reports/{id}/send refactor) + full regression of iterations 1-3. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (41 tests: contacts CRUD/scopes/primary auto-demote/isolation, settings email_from_address & email_reply_to, report send routing to/to_contacts/fallback, notify_upload WA guardrail, send_email payload assertions, notifiable_contacts_for helper). Final full-suite run: 166 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed. All 5 skips are external Resend proxy limits (429 rate-limit and 'undeliverable_recipient' 422 for fake/demo addresses), not product defects — successful sends (200 with `to` as a list, message_id, email_sent_to persisted) were verified in earlier runs of the same tests. No backend 5xx originating from application code.

minor.issue: `categories` is NOT validated against CONTACT_CATEGORIES (enum declared but unused): payload categories=['not_an_enum_value','<script>'] is accepted and persisted verbatim. function/scope/channels ARE validated.
No single-contact read route (returns 405). Frontend must fetch the whole list to display one contact.

Guarded by require_staff(), so a client gets 403 even on its OWN contacts. This matches the test spec but contradicts the module docstring ('Un client ne peut voir/gérer que les contacts de son propre tenant_id') and makes the client branch of _get_owned() dead code for pure clients. Clarify intent.
Duplicate emails within the same (scope, tenant_id) are allowed — same address can be notified twice via to_contacts.
email_from_address / email_reply_to are stored as free-form strings (no email-format validation). A typo silently breaks all outgoing mail (Resend rejects from_email).

Resend proxy answers 422 {'code':'undeliverable_recipient'} for demo addresses (e.g. client1@albarka-demo.bf) and 429 when several sends occur in the same second; the API surfaces both as a generic 502 'Échec envoi email'. Consider propagating the proxy diagnostic (like /admin/settings/wa/test does) so the cabinet can tell 'bad address' from 'rate limited'.

action_items: Validate contacts.categories against CONTACT_CATEGORIES (currently accepts arbitrary strings, including '<script>').

Wire notifiable_contacts_for(): it is implemented in albarka_contacts.py but never called by albarka_notifications (notify_echeance still only mails the client account, notify_upload only mails staff). The carnet d'adresses therefore does not yet receive échéance/upload notifications — only /reports/{id}/send uses contacts (via its own inline query, duplicating the helper's filter logic).
albarka_reports_mgmt.py imports html.escape but never uses it: client company/full_name and payload.message are interpolated raw into the email HTML — escape them (HTML-injection in outgoing mail).
Optionally add GET /api/contacts/{id} and decide whether clients may manage (not just read) their own carnet.
Optionally return the proxy diagnostic on send failures instead of a bare 502.
critical_code_review_comments: DRY: /reports/{id}/send re-implements the contact eligibility filter (is_active + can_receive_notifications + channels contains 'email') inline instead of reusing notifiable_contacts_for() — two filters can drift. Note the inline version DOES additionally scope by tenant_id (verified: a contact of another tenant is rejected with 400), whereas the helper always scopes by tenant, so unify around the helper with an explicit id filter.

notify_upload fans out WhatsApp sequentially with a 30s-timeout httpx client per staff member; with many staff this serialises the upload notification path. Consider asyncio.gather with a bounded semaphore.

Auto-demote of is_primary is a read-then-update_many without a transaction; two concurrent creates with is_primary=true can both end up primary. No unique partial index on (scope, tenant_id, is_primary) either. Low risk for this workload but worth noting.
albarka_contacts.py: `from albarka_auth import get_current_user, require_staff` — get_current_user used; ok. But CONTACT_CATEGORIES/CONTACT_SCOPES are only partially enforced (see categories).
Settings masking correctly excludes email_from_address/email_reply_to and still masks wa_access_token — verified.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (added run_async/fresh_async_env: Motor was bound to a closed event loop when several tests called asyncio.run in the same xdist worker)

/app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (stale assertions updated for iteration 3/4 behaviour: number regex now allows the SHA1[:4] discriminator, wa/test response now has a `diagnostic` field, send response `to` is now a list; made list/download tests self-sufficient instead of relying on list()[0]; added 429 retry/skip on report send)
/app/backend/tests/test_reports_notifications.py (uses shared run_async; external Resend 429 now skips instead of failing)

success_rate.backend: 100% (166/166 executed assertions passed; 5 tests skipped on external Resend limits)

seed_data_creation: All contacts/reports created by tests are prefixed TEST_ and deleted in fixtures teardown. Settings (email_from_address, email_reply_to, notif_upload_wa, wa_enabled, notif_upload_enabled) are saved and restored by each test.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 5 accounts (admin, superviseur, comptable, client1, client2) log in fine via /auth/login + dev_otp + /auth/verify-otp
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run everything with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q` (pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope). IMPORTANT: never call asyncio.run() directly on backend coroutines — Motor binds to the first loop and later asyncio.run() calls fail with 'Event loop is closed'; use conftest.run_async(lambda db: coro) which builds an isolated loop + Motor client and patches db/albarka_contacts/albarka_admin_settings globals. Email sends must target delivered@resend.dev (the Emergent proxy returns 422 undeliverable_recipient for other fake addresses and 429 when >1-2 sends/second) — tests skip on 502 by design. Contacts verified: scope client/cabinet, tenant_id required for client scope, 404 unknown client, 400 without email+phone, 403 for pure clients on write, enum validation for scope/function/channels, primary auto-demote on create and PATCH, client read isolation (cabinet + other tenants hidden even with ?scope=cabinet / ?tenant_id=other), staff filters, delete + 404 on re-delete.
rca_of_the_issue: Three iteration-3 regression failures at start were stale test expectations, not product bugs: (a) the report-number regex predated the SHA1[:4] client discriminator, (b) /admin/settings/wa/test now returns an extra `diagnostic` key, (c) /reports/{id}/send now returns `to` as a list (intended iteration-4 change). Two further failures were test-design fragility: tests picking reports via list()[0] raced with reports created/deleted by parallel modules, and Resend 429s. All fixed in test code only; no application code was modified.
